# lantronix-slcxx-o2 Provider

Manage Lantronix SecureLinx SLCxx-O2 console servers over their CLI (telnet transport).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Hostname or IP of the SLC management interface.

### Optional

- `command_timeout` (Number) Per-command timeout in seconds. Default 60 (network-affecting commands can take 60-120s).
- `login_retries` (Number) Extra full-login attempts after a rejection (device lockout guard). Default 1.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) CLI password. Falls back to `LANTRONIX_SLCXX_O2_PASSWORD`.
- `port` (Number) Telnet port. Defaults to 23.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) CLI user (full-CLI admin required). Defaults to sysadmin or `LANTRONIX_SLCXX_O2_USERNAME`.
